headline: Bitcoin Holds Above $80,000 Amid Post-Election Crypto Market Rebound
summary: Bitcoin held above $80,000 while Zcash jumped 12% and Ether rose 8% in a post-election crypto rebound aided by falling oil prices and a weaker dollar.
why: Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies trade globally and are influenced by broader macroeconomic liquidity, currency fluctuations, and regulatory expectations in the United States.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The input states that Bitcoin holds above $80,000 in a market rebound.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A weaker dollar and falling oil prices improved broader market sentiment, driving gains across major cryptocurrencies following the election.
